newsitem.title: JAPAN: Showa Denko says to raise stake in Showa Aluminum.
newsitem.headline: Showa Denko says to raise stake in Showa Aluminum.

text.p: Showa Denko KK, a leading chemical maker, said on Tuesday it would raise its stake in Showa Aluminum Corp to just over 50 percent to strengthen the Showa group"s aluminium operations.

Showa Denko said in a statement that it would buy four million Showa Aluminum shares from two Japanese banks and a non-group firm at a total cost of 2.42 billion yen and raise its stake in the unit to 50.05 percent from the current 48.04 percent. It said it would obtain the shares on February 21.
The purchase would "significantly" boost group sales and current profits for calendar 1997, it said.
It said it would announce a group earnings forecast for 1997 at the same time as it unveiled its business results for 1996. It did not say when it would announce the results.
